description: This file defines the interface for the rbus buffer management, including the rbusBuffer structure, buffer operations such as create, destroy, read, write, and encode/decode functions related to rbus values and filters. It also includes function prototypes for buffer serialization/deserialization and type-specific TLV writing methods.

classes.name: rbusBuffer
classes.description: Structure representing a dynamically managed byte buffer with fixed block and adjustable allocation.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_Create
methods.description: Initializes a new rbusBuffer instance, allocating memory and setting initial state.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up and deallocates resources used by the rbusBuffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_Reserve
methods.description: Reserves a specified amount of space in the buffer for subsequent write operations.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_Write
methods.description: Writes raw data into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteTypeLengthValue
methods.description: Writes a TLV (Type-Length-Value) formatted data segment into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteBooleanTLV
methods.description: Writes a boolean value in TLV format into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteCharTLV
methods.description: Writes a character value in TLV format into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteByteTLV
methods.description: Writes an unsigned byte in TLV format into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteInt8TLV
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit integer in TLV format into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteUInt8TLV
methods.description: Writes an unsigned 8-bit integer in TLV format into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteInt16TLV
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit integer in TLV format into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteUInt16TLV
methods.description: Writes an unsigned 16-bit integer in TLV format into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteInt32TLV
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit integer in TLV format into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteUInt32TLV
methods.description: Writes an unsigned 32-bit integer in TLV format into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteInt64TLV
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit integer in TLV format into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteUInt64TLV
methods.description: Writes an unsigned 64-bit integer in TLV format into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteSingleTLV
methods.description: Writes a float value in TLV format into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteDoubleTLV
methods.description: Writes a double value in TLV format into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteStringTLV
methods.description: Writes a string in TLV format into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteDateTimeTLV
methods.description: Writes a date/time structure in TLV format into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteBytesTLV
methods.description: Writes raw bytes in TLV format into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_Read
methods.description: Reads raw data from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadBoolean

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadChar
methods.description: Reads a character from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadByte

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadInt64
